metricHelp.mAP50: mAP50 — mean precision over classes at IoU ≥ 0.5: the main YOLO detection metric.
metricHelp.mAP50_95: mAP50-95 — the same averaged over IoU thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95: stricter to box accuracy. ultralytics picks the best weights by it.
metricHelp.precision: Precision — the share of detections that were correct. Low — the model often sees an object where there is none.
metricHelp.recall: Recall — the share of real objects the model found. Low — the model misses a lot.
